niche: make-good bore assessments at an open-cut coal mine in central Queensland whose pit has been dewatered since mid-2022: which neighbouring landholders' water bores have lost more water level to the mine's take than the trigger threshold for their aquifer, through two dry years that lowered every shallow bore in the district
stakeholder_role: principal hydrogeologist at the mine, who recommends which landholders are offered make-good agreements

spine.entity: one water-level observation at one bore: a manual dip by the field team or one day's mean from a pressure logger

world.geography: Australia, central Queensland (Isaac region, Bowen Basin)
world.org_type: an open-cut coal mine owned by a mid-sized mining company, whose pit dewatering takes associated water from the coal measures

driver: When every unit's level follows a shared external driver through its own lagged response, a change measured from a fixed baseline mixes that response with the effect being assessed, so the effect is the gap between the observed level and each unit's own driver-only path fitted before the effect began, which hides large effects where the driver was lifting the level and invents them where it was pulling it down.
driver_concrete: Each landholder bore's level since the pit's dewatering began in July 2022 is set against the make-good trigger for its aquifer (2 m in the alluvium, 5 m in the coal measures and basalt); the alluvial bores fell 2 to 4 m through the dry 2023 to 2025 seasons on rainfall alone, while the coal-measure bores, still rising on the slow recharge of the 2020 to 2022 wet years, were held 5 to 8 m below where that recharge would have taken them and show less than a metre of net decline.
stump: A competent solver converts every dip to a reduced level, compares each bore since July 2022 with its pre-mining baseline (or with the reference bores outside the predicted drawdown) and offers make good to the alluvial bores that fell past 2 m; the step that lands it there is reading the decline from the baseline as the mine's drawdown, when the alluvium's fall is the dry years' and the coal measures' small net change hides a large drawdown under a recovery the wet years had set going.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who turns every reading into a reduced level, drops pumped and duplicate dips, compensates the loggers for air pressure and applies each aquifer's trigger exactly still measures each bore's decline from its baseline (or against the reference bores) and designates the alluvial bores; only a model of each bore's own response to rainfall and evaporation, calibrated before dewatering and run forward as the level without the mine, shows which bores the mine has drawn down past their trigger.
domain_test: What decides the set is attributing groundwater-level change between climate-driven recharge and pumping with response functions calibrated on each bore's pre-impact record, which is how hydrogeologists assess drawdown impacts on neighbouring bores; with another field's nouns there is no recharge, no aquifer memory that differs between shallow and deep bores and no drawdown cone, so the task does not read the same.
layer1: depth to water below a measuring point that changed when headworks were rebuilt, against reduced levels in metres AHD
landholder dips taken while the bore's own pump was running (pumped, not static, levels) flagged only in a free-text remark
unvented pressure loggers that need the site barometric logger subtracted, and logger drift corrected to the manual dips
bores known by a state registered number, the landholder's name for it and the company's monitoring code
pre-2012 readings in feet on transcribed field sheets, and duplicate dips entered twice
notes: Re-root of seed AD05 at the draw (see slot_note). Anomaly Detection & Diagnostics: which bores show a drawdown the mine caused, as against the dry years' decline. decisive_rule_filed is true: the make-good procedure files the trigger (a decline attributable to the mine's take beyond 2 m in unconsolidated and 5 m in consolidated aquifers) and the baseline assessment, and nothing files how the attributable part is estimated; no filed document defines the decline as the baseline minus the current level, so there is no official decoy. calibration_form is other: reference bores outside the predicted zone of influence show the climate-only model holds after July 2022. org_family is other (a coal mining company) and role_family is other (a hydrogeologist).
